name: pr-watch
description: A line above the prompt for each pull request Claude opens: its GitHub workflows with a progress bar, then ready to merge, the failing job, or what blocks it.

wake.title: Wake Claude
wake.description: Tell Claude when a watched pull request is ready to merge, a job fails, it conflicts or someone asks for changes, a merge's checks finish, or someone else comments or reviews. Off, only you hear it, from the line and its toasts.

botComments.title: Bot comments wake Claude
botComments.description: Also tell Claude of comments and reviews whose author GitHub marks as a bot, such as plan comments, coverage reports and review bots. A person's always do.
